author: evidence_builder independent test-design lane
originalSpecClarification: Engineering UAT-07 is malicious document instruction, not browser acceptance. Browser basis is FR-20 plus Hamilton H07-AC2; UAT-09 supplies mixed-scope composition.

requirements.behavior: Complete actual reports, research and board-brief journeys at both widths with separate diagnostic evidence.
Never infer client action settlement or persisted effects solely from transport, navigation or authored UI success.
Bind each actual saved artifact and export to exact actor/institution/action identity and independent fixture truth.
Fail closed on stale/replayed/mismatched/missing provenance and required skips.
Keep capture passive/private and execution isolated, with production permissions separate.
Report exact measured populations; before/after, recurrence and false-block rate remain unmeasured until evidence exists.

cases.name: Full report-builder journey at both widths
cases.given: Run the actual signed-in report builder separately at 1440x900 and 390x844 using the frozen CCB fixture. Select Board summary, include What to resolve first, move it first, choose Committee layout, export, then choose Committee fee review.

required: completed PDF download with parsed content and section order from independent fixture truth
expected.effectKind: download; no database report insertion is required for report_builder
expected.eligibility: Candidate local synthetic acceptance only; never native approval or production verification

cases.baselineFeasibility: Existing actual run at f3d79 has both callbacks passed but strict runner failed; retained result is blocked, not full acceptance

required: full action chain at each width; a resized final page does not replace full phone execution
saved native snapshot subject and exact peer/source membership
same artifact reopened in a fresh same-user context

cases.baselineFeasibility: Actual research callback passed but strict capture failed; full phone chain and native save binding remain unproved

source analysis and added findings retained

saved title/note and evidence flags equal intended inputs
PDF parsed identity, title, note, 32 tested and 27 current fee, dates, sources and limitations
no substitution of live data or an unrelated row

cases.baselineFeasibility: Requires authorized isolated loopback fixture DB/browser later; no new run is performed for this design

fresh screenshot and completed client action/read

ten original peers and Florida seven unchanged

cases.name: Full matrix has no hidden serial skip

distinguish callback result, Playwright result, protocol, application settlement, persisted effect and export

cases.name: Concurrent same-URL POST requests cannot borrow completion
cases.given: In one document issue two distinct native POST requests at the same route; only one reaches EOF/app completion and the other is canceled or still open.

required: distinct generated request and action-attempt identities
completion/effect belongs only to exact matched request

cases.baselineFeasibility: Existing protocol transport negative control can run unchanged; new action binding needs an importable fail-closed implementation seam

cases.name: Same URL in separate sessions/documents is not a match

required: scope includes exact registered context/session/frame/document and redirect hop

cases.baselineFeasibility: Existing regression control, not evidence of new action capability

cases.name: Redirect receipt is a transition, never original EOF
cases.given: A POST/GET redirects and the destination completes in a new request hop.

required: no fulfilled original action inferred from destination

cases.name: HTTP200 before body completion is insufficient

cases.name: Canceled POST stays unsettled after same-document navigation
cases.given: A nextAction POST returns200 then aborts; history/router navigation changes the route in the same document and UI displays a destination.
cases.baselineFeasibility: Existing policy negative remains unchanged; no cancellation exception authorized

cases.name: Full document load also does not fulfill an old POST
cases.given: A canceled POST is followed by an unrelated document response200 and load.
cases.baselineFeasibility: Existing regression control

cases.name: Same-document canceled RSC GET cannot borrow a full-navigation exception

required: preserve exact metadata and same-document kind
ordinary RSC fetch is not relabeled prefetch
strictv1 remains blocked unless its complete existing predicate actually holds

cases.baselineFeasibility: Genuine actual strict false-block hypothesis exists; no authorized new classifier success expectation exists yet

cases.name: Event-order ties cannot be repaired by wall-clock guesses

no cross-system ID or timestamp ordering without native relation

cases.baselineFeasibility: Existing transport replay controls plus future action-ordering extension

different prior turns are not the same request
